headline: 🚨 THE WILLOW POINT CONTRACT IS DEAD AND YOUR SELLER CAUGHT A MACHINE-AUTHORED FALSE CLAIM BEFORE THE FLEET DID — you ruled the offer dead at 7:12 this morning, and at 11:58 Sondra S. wrote back to ask why the report she was auto-sent at 8:30 promised her a Tuesday tour: it does not exist. Only Wednesday 9/2 6:00 PM is real, verified against eight days of receipts. ⭐ SHE IS OWED A CALL, NOT A CORRECTION EMAIL — a client beat your own desk to a wrong number on her own house, and that is the one thing on this board that costs trust rather than time. ✅ THE MORNING ITSELF RAN CLEAN: eleven routines between 5:15 and 12:15, the Monday command sheet and nine client drafts shipped at 8:33, and the Brivity deep sweep came back off yesterday's block. · DO: call Sondra S. — correct the tour, then talk about what a dead contract means for Wednesday · DECIDE: 355 Comanche expires 9/8 and just booked tour #21 — price talk now or ride it out · WATCH: 195 Lake View still shows no funding receipt, day 3 (re-verified 8/31 11:05a).

notes: 🚨 A CLIENT CAUGHT THE MACHINE BEING WRONG ABOUT HER OWN HOUSE, AND SHE CAUGHT IT FIRST. The seller report auto-sent at 8:30 this morning carried a “2 BOOKED” tile and named a Tuesday 9/1 6:00 PM tour. Eight days of showing receipts were then enumerated one by one: only Wednesday 9/2 6:00 PM exists. There is no Tuesday record anywhere. ⭐ The seller wrote in at 11:58 asking about it — roughly three and a half hours after the mail went out and before any routine noticed. The report lane is now flagged, further machine email to her is stopped by rule, and the correction is a voice call, not another email.

↩️ THE BLOCK FROM YESTERDAY AFTERNOON CLEARED ON ITS OWN THIS MORNING. The Brivity deep sweep, wedged since 4:47 PM Sunday, ran at 8:39 and proved its write path is live — and then found the real defect underneath the eight-run “import tool missing” story: the create-lead call is an UPSERT, so it reports “created” while overwriting whatever record it matched. It hit a teammate's trashed record on the first try and hard-stopped itself after one import rather than repeat it. ⚠️ Two of its seven parts are still idle: the geography pass and the seller-import lane.

📞 THE VOICEMAIL FORWARD HAS BEEN BOUNCING 100% SINCE 8/18 — found at 12:15 today, two weeks after it started. ⭐ THE HONEST PART: zero leads were lost to it. Every voicemail in the window was independently accounted for, so this is a dead instrument rather than a hole in the pipeline — but it means “no voicemail email” has meant nothing for thirteen days. 📅 Separately, the October 9 Further Together event was cancelled by the organizer over the weekend; the March actuals and the app build from that work survive for the next round.

callBlock.why: Your Willow Point seller. She wrote in at 11:58 asking why the report promised her a Tuesday showing — it does not exist, and the contract on her house died this morning. Two corrections, one call, and it should be your voice.

Came back on her own after forty-eight days and said the value you sent on her Fulmar Drive house looked RIGHT. A seller volunteering agreement with your number is as close to a listing appointment as a lead gets. Reply is drafted.
Day eleven on a promise you made him in writing on 8/20 — he asked again at 10:50 this morning, “we ever hear from these guys?” It is his commercial spot, and the clock is on you, not him.
Seller hand-raise on a Chelsea Park address, came in Saturday, first-touch email went out at 7:12 today. He is warm right now and nobody has spoken to him.
Helena home-value hand-raise, landed 4:46 PM Sunday and held overnight by rule. Helena is your number-one farm, and the reply draft is staged.
Seller hand-raise on a North Port FL address who typed a live objection into the form — he thinks the estimate is too low. That is an opening, not a complaint.
On your site browsing for twenty-nine minutes in the high-$600s, and nobody has called since 8/24. A year in the database, never touched.
Texted his buy-box back unprompted — 4 bed / 3.5–4 bath, up to $300K. A written reply with real criteria, now ten days cold.

listings.status: 🔴 BACK ON THE MARKET — you ruled the contract dead at 7:12 this morning, and the seller found out the machine had her tour wrong
listings.note: 🔴 TWO THINGS BROKE HERE TODAY AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS THE DEAL. ✅ THE OFFER IS DEAD BY YOUR OWN RULING — logged at 7:12 this morning, which ends six days of chasing a number nobody could open. The price inside that PDF was never read and now never needs to be. 🚨 THE SECOND BREAK IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS: the seller report auto-sent at 8:30 told your seller she had two tours booked and named a Tuesday 9/1 6:00 PM appointment. Eight days of receipts say only WEDNESDAY 9/2 6:00 PM exists. She wrote in at 11:58 asking about it herself — a client caught a machine-authored false claim on her own house before this desk did. 🎯 ONE CALL FIXES BOTH: the Tuesday tour is not real, Wednesday is, and a dead contract with a fresh brokerage booked behind it is a better position than it sounds. Machine email to her is now stopped by rule; this is voice only.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — closes 9/21, the read is done, the plan is sent, the call is still not made
listings.note: 🏆 YOU DID THE HARD HALF ON SATURDAY MORNING: sixty-three pages read line by line, 116 items sorted into seven categories, and a written game plan to your seller before 8:40 AM. 🔴 WHAT IS LEFT IS THE PART YOU PROMISED TWICE IN WRITING — a call. The record now shows two “tomorrows” and no voice on either, and a full weekend has passed. It is on today's board at 8:30. 🎯 THREE PILES BEFORE YOU DIAL — fix, credit, decline. A seller who hears three piles instead of nineteen items says yes on the call. ✅ Title came back clean and the taxes are current.

listings.status: ⏳ CLOSING — day 3 past the appointment, re-verified at 11:05 this morning, and still nothing says the money moved
listings.note: ⏳ TODAY WAS SUPPOSED TO BE THE ANSWER AND IT IS HALF OVER. The closing ran Friday afternoon; the milestone engine re-checked at 11:05 and held this at CLOSING — no deposit alert, no payday notice, no funding receipt anywhere. ⭐ THE INNOCENT EXPLANATION IS ON THE RECORD: the seller took a check rather than a wire, banks were shut all weekend, and a check settles quietly. Monday is the first banking day since — but the banking day is running out. 🎯 THIS BOARD WILL NOT COUNT IT UNTIL SOMETHING SAYS THE MONEY LANDED, which is why the year still reads 23. 📄 The settlement statement that would end the commission question is still unread in the title portal, and the coordinator call about it is a p1 on today's lane.

listings.status: 🗣️ ACTIVE — day 40, and the first real feedback this house ever produced is now four days old and still untold
listings.note: 🗣️ ON ONLY ITS SECOND TOUR EVER, THIS LISTING FINALLY SAID SOMETHING. The buyers liked plenty and then named two things: it reads dated for the asking price, and the air conditioning was struggling. ⚠️ EVERY PRICE FIELD ON THE FORM WAS LEFT BLANK — no number, no “too high” box ticked — so this is a condition read, not a price verdict, and it must not be carried to the seller as one. 🔴 THE SELLER STILL HAS NOT HEARD IT, day 4, and it was on this morning's board at 9:00. 🎯 The AC line is the useful half: checkable, fixable, and the reason to call rather than email.

listings.status: 🆕 ACTIVE — tour #21 just booked for TOMORROW, and the agreement expires 9/8
listings.note: 🆕 THE ONE NEW EVENT ON THE WHOLE SHOWING BOARD SINCE SUNDAY LANDED HERE AT 8:40 THIS MORNING: Chad B. of RE/MAX Advantage booked TUESDAY 9/1 4:30–5:30 PM, his first visit, the twenty-first showing on this house. ⭐ HE RESERVED A FULL HOUR, roughly double the twenty-five-minute slot most agents take — worth noting, not worth claiming as intent. 🔍 THE STANDING FINDING IS UNCHANGED AND IT IS STRONG: two independent brokerages gave the identical verdict — “stairs were too steep” off Friday's tour and the same answer on 8/13 — and BOTH left every price field blank. Two agents, two offices, one physical objection, zero price objections. ⏳ Saturday's 9:45 AM tour has still filed nothing at about 51 hours, and the unqualified YES from 8/15 has never been called back. 🎯 Eight days to expiry and a tour tomorrow: this is the week the seller conversation happens.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — day 161, the listing agreement is expiring, and Friday's read is now ~96 hours overdue
listings.note: ⚠️ THE DEADLINE IS THE STORY, NOT THE TRAFFIC. The brokerage flagged that this listing agreement is expiring, and a seller's-disclosure revision was requested alongside it. 🔴 THE PRICE CONVERSATION YOU TOLD THIS CLIENT YOU OWED HIM ON 8/24 IS STILL OPEN, and an expiring agreement is the moment it costs least to have. ⏳ Friday's midday tour — the eleventh on this unit — has filed nothing in about 96 hours, and the access question that agent asked (Supra or lockbox) still has no answer anywhere on record.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — 45 tours, no offer, and the September block still holds
listings.note: ⚠️ FRIDAY'S TOUR CANCELLED TWO MINUTES BEFORE THE APPOINTMENT and the reason is the most useful sentence this listing has produced in weeks: the buyer “fell in love with one we just saw” and never entered the house. ⭐ THAT IS NOT A PRICING VERDICT and this board does not report it as one — the counter reads showings-by-this-agent zero. 📅 WHAT STILL HOLDS: one brand-new agent has reserved Sat 9/12 9:00 AM and Sun 9/13 9:00 AM back to back, two consecutive mornings on a house with forty-five tours and no offer. 🎯 Forty-five walks with no offer is a price story wearing a traffic story's clothes.

listings.status: ✅ THE NUMBER IS DELIVERED — and it is now wired into the tracking that missed it
listings.note: ✅ THE VALUE REPORT IS DELIVERED and the gap is on the table: your supported range against the number he had in his head. 🔧 THE FOLDER GAP CLOSED TODAY — this morning's sync flagged it as the one address live on the board but missing from tracked folders, and the milestone engine seeded it at 8:30 as COMING SOON rather than ACTIVE, deliberately, so the real go-live still fires instead of being permanently suppressed. ⭐ THE REAL ARGUMENT TURNED OUT NOT TO BE PRICE — it is what the pool and the lot actually buy him against the comparable sales, and that is an argument you win with paper. 📋 STILL OPEN: his price decision, and flipping the agreement over to Client.

✅ THE FILE IS HEALTHY AND ON SCHEDULE. ⚠️ Two quiet items remain and both are paperwork rather than condition, and both are now eleven days old — the inspection requests have been sitting with your seller since 8/20. 🎯 Two weeks out from a closing is the last comfortable moment to clear paperwork; after that it becomes a rush.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — roof addendum fully signed, closes 10/23
listings.note: 🎉 BOTH SELLERS HAVE SIGNED and the file has now held steady at inspection through eleven consecutive engine runs — the quietest file you own. 🔍 Only the escrow holdback sizing remains loose, and it is not urgent at eight weeks out.

listings.status: 📅 COMING SOON — 22.63 acres, price ruled at $575K, list date still blank
listings.note: ⏳ THE ANSWER THIS LISTING NEEDED ARRIVED TEN DAYS AGO AND NOBODY PICKED IT UP — your coordinator posted the gate code to the shared board on 8/21 and it has sat in Questions for Gene with zero comments ever since. 📋 STILL OPEN BEHIND IT: the perc documentation and the covenants. ⭐ The price is ruled at $575K; everything blocking the launch is paperwork and one unread board card.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — price cut live, no tours in the window, and this morning's wrong-claim card was caught before it published
listings.note: 🔧 A REAL CATCH THIS MORNING, TWO AND A HALF HOURS BEFORE IT PUBLISHED: this listing's branded card had been rendered last week carrying an overstated sales claim, and it was attached to a post scheduled for 7:30 today. The card was re-rendered, re-hosted and the post re-pointed before it fired. ⚠️ WHAT IS STILL YOURS TO FIX: a post from 8/20 still shows the old price, and only you can delete it — the machine cannot reach that account.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE at $599K — highest lead yield you own, and the buy-boxes keep getting clearer
listings.note: 🔍 THE FURTHEST-ALONG BUYER ANSWERED AND IT IS A NO — he wants un-entitled acreage. ⭐ THAT IS A BUY-BOX, NOT A REJECTION, and it is worth more than a maybe: it tells you which builder profile to stop pitching and which to chase. 📤 The document package went to a builder on Thursday, and per your own rule it went without mentioning perc.

listings.status: 📭 COMING SOON — first weekday half gone, calendar still empty
listings.note: 📭 IT WENT LIVE ON A SUNDAY AND THE CALENDAR IS STILL BLANK AT MIDDAY MONDAY — no request, no confirmation, no cancellation on a fresh fourteen-day pull. ⏳ That is not yet a verdict; it is half of one weekday. ⭐ Willow Point is the argument for patience on exactly this point: it ran paid ads for three days with no tours, then took five bookings and a signed offer in eleven days once the market found it. 🎯 What would change the read is the afternoon — if nothing books by tonight, this needs a marketing push rather than more waiting.

pipeline.paceProjection: 📈 THE WEEKLY FORECAST RAN AT 5:51 THIS MORNING AND THE NUMBER IS 23 OF 45 — seven behind pace, re-derived live rather than carried. ⏳ NUMBER TWENTY-FOUR CLOSED ON PAPER FRIDAY AND THIS BOARD IS STILL COUNTING 23, DELIBERATELY: day three past the appointment, re-verified at 11:05 today, and nothing anywhere says the money moved. A scheduled closing is not a closed one. 🔴 AND THE PIPELINE LOST A FILE TODAY, NOT A DEAL — the Willow Point contract was ruled dead at 7:12 this morning, so that house goes back to the active column and out of the forecast. The board's 4.70 expected closings and about $40,775 of weighted GCI were derived at 5:51, BEFORE that ruling: treat both as one file high until the next forecast run re-derives them. 📊 WHAT IT MOVES: at day 243, 23 closings annualises to about 34.6 — a third straight day under the 35 survive line; twenty-four takes the run rate past 36. ⏳ WHAT IS ACTUALLY BEHIND IT NOW: 198 Rena with a clean commitment closing 9/21, 3350 Altamont on 9/14, and 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23 outside the window. Anything closing inside 2026 must be under contract by roughly Oct 31 — nine weeks from today. 👥 Team pace is 37 against 90 on the latest verified sheet.

money.note: 🔴 THE 5:5xa ALERT STILL STANDS AND NOTHING NEW HAS LANDED SINCE — the inbox was swept again at midday and there is no second bank notice, no new return, no new low-balance mail. That is the honest read: unchanged, not improved. ⚠️ A RETURNED ITEM ON THE PERSONAL ACCOUNT IS CONFIRMED FOR 8/28, the second inside five days, found by a 96-hour scan that deliberately widened across the weekend and opened every alert body rather than reading subject lines. ⏳ TOMORROW IS A DRAFT DATE AND THE BUSINESS BALANCE THAT WOULD COVER IT IS NOW PAST SEVENTY HOURS STALE — by this desk's own rule that makes it formally UNKNOWN, not low. ✅ One alarm was retired honestly this morning: the insurance bounce that ran red for two days had drafted from the business account and cleared; the correction was printed rather than quietly dropped. 🎯 HALF THE BANKING DAY IS LEFT. Reading both transaction lists yourself is still the single highest-value five minutes on this board — no routine can see inside those accounts.

isa.decayPolicy: 🔍 59 OPEN ROWS IN THE CALL LANE AT MIDDAY — 51 of them due or overdue and 24 at p1. ⚠️ THAT IS UP FROM 41 THIS MORNING, and the growth is real work, not noise: this morning's runs added a seller reply, a client question, an eleven-day promise to Tyler H., and two research rows on unnamed sellers. ⭐ WHAT THE PILE ACTUALLY IS MATTERS MORE THAN ITS SIZE — dozens of the overdue rows are named human beings with phone numbers who raised a hand about one of YOUR listings and have never been called. Median wait four days, oldest fourteen. That is not a backlog, it is a queue of people. 🔴 THE OLDEST SELLER ROWS ARE IN HELENA, your number-one farm zip — one asked what her house was worth, another tagged himself ‘call me’ to sell in March. Neither has ever been called. ⚖️ AND A ONE-WORD RULING IS STILL WAITING ON YOU about whether this board should auto-expire at all — asked on 8/16, and the pile has roughly tripled since.
isa.sweepCadence: every 20 to 30 minutes while the fleet is up — eleven sweeps logged since 6:25 this morning. 📤 THE WINDOW OPENED ON THE DOT AND DID THE DAY'S BEST WORK IN ITS FIRST SIX MINUTES: three seller first-touches held all through Sunday went out at 7:12, each screened against the stop-request and reply-handoff registers first. Nothing was emailed on a Sunday and nothing was lost by waiting. ✅ SINCE THEN: sixteen more sends across the follow-up arcs, three Brivity texts finally shipped after the composer was solved with a direct click, five stale draft rows cleared, and a past-client reply caught two minutes after it landed. 🔍 TWO FINDS WORTH KEEPING. The Rule-0 ownership fallback reaches about 7–13 days of history, not six months — which explains two leads that could not be paid for and stops that theory being re-litigated. And the Brivity import tool was alive the whole time: the liveness TEST could never pass, so eight sweeps chased a phantom outage. ⚠️ Still open: the geography and seller-import parts of the deep sweep did no work again today.
